muc.title: Advertised rate vs real rate
muc.text: Loan ads show a low rate, but add all the fees and change the calculation method, and the real cost can be much higher.

muc.title: Hide personal details
muc.text: Cover your name and ID number on the loan papers, then ask a chatbot, an AI assistant you chat with, to explain each line.

muc.title: Original or reducing balance
muc.text: Ask AI whether interest is charged on the original amount or on the reducing balance, and to list every fee.

muc.title: Statement date and due date
muc.text: For credit cards, ask AI to explain the statement date, the due date, and what happens if you only pay the minimum.

muc.title: Calculate the total
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to calculate the total you'd repay on a sample loan, then take your questions to the bank.
